definition: a man who solders (as his profession); a solderer.
example_en: The solderer repaired the broken vessel.

definition: the act, manner or power of flying or moving through space; flight.
example_en: The bird's flight soared high into the sky.

definition: to make a pair by joining oneself with another.
example: ಇಬ್ಬರೂ ಸ್ನೇಹಿತರು ಒಟ್ಟಿಗೆ ಕೆಲಸ ಮಾಡಲು ಎಣೆಕಟ್ಟಿದರು.
example_en: The two friends paired up to work together.

definition: the abode of Brahma.
example_en: According to the Puranas, the abode of Brahma is in heaven.

definition: the cardinal number two thousand; 2000.
example_en: That king had two thousand soldiers.

definition: the plant Rhynchosia minima of Papilionaceae family.
example_en: The plant Rhynchosia minima grows on the slope of the hill.

definition: (dial.) a quantity of two bagful of grains, used as a unit of measurement of quantity.
example_en: The farmer measured out one ēru of paddy.

definition: a woman who can read and write; a literate woman.
example: ಆ ಹಳ್ಳಿಯ ಲಿಪಿಜ್ಞೆ ಪತ್ರಗಳನ್ನು ಓದಿ ಬರೆದುಕೊಡುತ್ತಿದ್ದಳು.
example_en: The literate woman of that village used to read and write letters for others.

definition: a round, big baglike mammary organ containing two or more glands (chiefly of a cow).
example_en: They milked the cow from its large udder.

definition: a gay, light-hearted action or mood; fun; joking.
example_en: He likes fun and light-hearted joking with friends very much.

definition: (jain.) any of the common superstitious beliefs.
example: ಆ ಗ್ರಂಥ ಜೈನ ಸಂಪ್ರದಾಯದ ಲೋಕಮೂಢಗಳನ್ನು ವಿವರಿಸುತ್ತದೆ.
example_en: That text explains the common superstitious beliefs of the Jain tradition.

definition: agreement in feeling, action, ideas, interests, etc.; peaceable or friendly relations; harmony; an association marked by compatibility.
example: ಆ ಇಬ್ಬರು ಸ್ನೇಹಿತರ ನಡುವೆ ಗಾಢವಾದ ಪೊರ್ದಿಗೆ ಬೆಳೆಯಿತು.
example_en: A deep harmony grew between those two friends.

definition: a battle or combat.
example: ಎರಡು ಸೈನ್ಯಗಳ ನಡುವೆ ಭಯಂಕರ ಹೋರಟೆ ನಡೆಯಿತು.
example_en: A terrible battle took place between the two armies.

definition: to put shackles on; to fetter.
example_en: The soldiers put shackles on the prisoner.

definition: an invitation for a dinner or a feast.
example: ಮದುವೆಗೆ ಔತಳ ಬಂದ ಕೂಡಲೇ ಎಲ್ಲರೂ ಸಂತೋಷಪಟ್ಟರು.
example_en: As soon as the wedding invitation came, everyone was happy.

definition: a military projectile used in ancient warfare to hurl heavy objects against the defensive wall of the fortified place of one's enemy.
example: ಢೆಂಕಣದ ಹೊಡೆತಕ್ಕೆ ಕೋಟೆಯ ಗೋಡೆ ಬಿರುಕು ಬಿಟ್ಟಿತು.
example_en: The fort wall cracked from the blow of the projectile.

definition: the origin of the life of a person.
example_en: That very village was the origin of his life.

definition: a kind of jute plant.
example_en: The farmers grew the small jute plant along the side of the field.

definition: a competent, capable person.
example_en: There was a need for competent people in the work.

definition: to utter a word; to speak.
example_en: Out of fear he did not utter even a word.

definition: placing trust, confidence on; showing one's loyalty to.
example_en: His conduct was indicative of trust and loyalty.

definition: the essential character or nature of a thing.
example: ಆ ವಸ್ತುವಿನ ದ್ರವ್ಯಶಕ್ತಿಯನ್ನು ವಿಜ್ಞಾನಿಗಳು ಅಧ್ಯಯನ ಮಾಡಿದರು.
example_en: Scientists studied the essential nature of that substance.

definition: a noisy rushing about; confusion; bustle; commotion.
example_en: The grandmother was annoyed by the children's noisy bustle.

definition: to take (a child) on to one's lap.
example_en: The grandfather took his grandchild onto his lap and fondled him.

definition: the funeral fire.
example_en: The funeral fire burned throughout the night.

definition: an optical illusion, in which a water-body is seen, caused by the refraction of light in the hot air; a mirage.
example_en: The mirage shimmered in the sunlit plain.

definition: the condition of being soaked (thoroughly) (as in water).
example_en: The soaked state of the cloth has not yet dried.

definition: that which is printed in a newspaper, at the final stage of its printing; latest news.
example_en: People were waiting to read the newspaper's latest news.

definition: the quality of being passionless, placid.
example_en: Seeing the saint's passionless calm, the people became peaceful.

definition: a small, circular plastic band used to tie hair around it as to give the hair a ring-shape.
example_en: She tied a red hair band around her hair.

definition: the red or yellowish fruit (berry) of the annual plant Lycopersicon esculentum of Solanaceae family, with a juicy pulp, used as a vegetable; tomato.
example_en: Red tomatoes have grown well in the garden.

definition: a kind of two-wheeled passenger-cart drawn by a horse.
example_en: We went to the town sitting in a horse-drawn cart.

definition: a going or coming back; withdrawing; a retreat.
example_en: Peace came to the town due to the enemy force's retreat.

definition: the eastern quarter.
example_en: Sunrise occurs from the eastern quarter.

definition: to cease to live; to die.
example_en: That soldier died in the war.

definition: the superintendent of a kitchen (in a palace).
example: ಬಾಣಸವೆರ್ಗಡೆ ಪ್ರತಿ ದಿನ ಹೊಸ ಖಾದ್ಯಗಳನ್ನು ತಯಾರಿಸಿದನು.
example_en: The kitchen superintendent prepared new dishes every day.

definition: to receive, collect interest on money lent.
example: ಆತ ಸಾಲ ಕೊಟ್ಟು ಪ್ರತಿ ತಿಂಗಳು ಬಡ್ಡಿಗೊಳ್ಳುತ್ತಾನೆ.
example_en: He lends money and collects interest every month.

definition: arrogant; haughty; headstrong.
example: ಆತನ ಗಬ್ಬಿ ಸ್ವಭಾವ ಎಲ್ಲರಿಗೂ ಅಸಮಾಧಾನ ತಂದಿತು.
example_en: His arrogant nature displeased everyone.

definition: a condition that is causing irritation or annoyance; irritation; an uncomfortable situation.
example_en: The whole night became an irritating trouble because of mosquitoes.

definition: sexual intercourse; coition.
example: ಹಳೆಯ ಕಾವ್ಯದಲ್ಲಿ ಸುಸಿಲ್ ಎಂಬ ಪದವನ್ನು ಬಳಸಿದ್ದಾರೆ.
example_en: In the old poem, the word susil has been used.

definition: (dizziness) to affect a person.
example_en: Dizziness affected him when he stood in the sun.

definition: a clothing worn close to the skin (as an innerwear).
example_en: In winter, he wore a close-fitting inner garment.

definition: the staff of death; the emblem of Yama, the god of death.
example_en: Yama stood holding the staff of death.

definition: an old unit of measure of capacity.
example: ಹಳೆಯ ಲೆಕ್ಕದಲ್ಲಿ ಒರ್ಮಾನ ಒಂದು ಅಳತೆಯ ಘಟಕವಾಗಿತ್ತು.
example_en: In the old system, an ormāna was a unit of measure.

definition: an applying of cosmetics to the face.
example_en: Before the wedding she applied cosmetics to her face.

definition: to make a sectarial mark with sandal paste, saffron, etc. on (another's or one's) forehead.
example_en: The mother applied a vermilion mark on the child's forehead.

definition: a watch-house.
example_en: A watch-house had been built near the fort.

definition: the state of being unmoved, stand still.
example_en: Even amid the storm, the tree stood unmoved.

definition: to suffer the pain; to undergo difficulties, annoyances; to be annoyed.
example_en: That family suffered a great deal in poverty.

definition: money paid to an employee for work done, and usu. based on daily basis; wages.
example_en: They gave the worker his week's wages in the evening.

definition: the tree Aleurites triloba of Euphorbiaceae family; walnut tree.
example_en: The seed of the walnut tree is used for oil.

definition: a proper or good state or condition.
example_en: The fruits have now come to a good state of ripeness.

definition: (growth of someone or something) to be checked; to be stunted.
example_en: The seedling's growth was checked by the heat.

definition: the act of hiding, concealing.
example_en: The thieves concealed themselves and hid in the forest.

definition: to flow or leak out slowly; to ooze.
example_en: Water was slowly oozing out from the wall.

definition: the state of emotional ecstasy or being greatly agitated by strong feelings.
example: ಸಂಗೀತ ಕೇಳಿ ಆಕೆಗೆ ಒಂದು ಬಗೆಯ ಝಪಾಟಿ ಉಂಟಾಯಿತು.
example_en: Hearing the music, she was overcome by a kind of emotional ecstasy.

definition: a particular mode of abstract conemplation, forcing the mind to abstain from external objects.
example_en: He steadied his mind through forced contemplation.

definition: to shine brightly.
example_en: The lightning shone brightly among the clouds.

definition: added; included; appended; annexed; accompanied.
example_en: They sent a certificate appended to the letter.

definition: the act or legal offence of imitating or counterfeiting documents to deceive; forgery.
example: ಆ ವ್ಯಕ್ತಿಯ ಮೇಲೆ ದಾಖಲೆಗಳ ತೋತಾಯದ ಆರೋಪವಿತ್ತು.
example_en: That person was accused of forgery of documents.

definition: (dial.) a question or statement so framed as to exercise one's ingenuity in answering it or discovering its meaning; a conundrum.
example_en: The children tried to solve the conundrum.

definition: that which is eaten as food.
example_en: One cannot live without food.

definition: complete darkness.
example: ವಿದ್ಯುತ್ ಹೋಗುತ್ತಿದ್ದಂತೆ ಇಡೀ ಊರು ಸಂತಮಸದಲ್ಲಿ ಮುಳುಗಿತು.
example_en: As soon as the power went off, the whole town was plunged into complete darkness.

definition: to knock down.
example_en: He knocked down the wall with a pickaxe.

definition: to keep in check, control.
example_en: The teacher kept the students under control.

definition: temporary loss of one's bodily awareness, resulting from rapture, melody, tiredness, etc.; the state of being stupefied.
example_en: As she listened to the music, she was overcome by a stupor of rapture.

definition: at once; immediately; without delay; all at the same time.
example_en: Hearing the news, he stood up at once.

definition: a hateful, reprehensible woman.
example_en: That hateful woman was troubling all the neighbours.

definition: a device for taking photographs, consisting essentially of a closed box containing a sensitised plate or film on which an image is formed when light enters the box through a lens or hole; a camera.
example_en: He bought a new camera.

definition: an instance of defeating or overcoming one's enemy or adversary.
example: ಸೈನಿಕರ ಜಯನ ಇಡೀ ರಾಜ್ಯಕ್ಕೆ ಸಂತೋಷ ತಂದಿತು.
example_en: The soldiers' victory over the enemy brought joy to the whole kingdom.

definition: Vālmīki, the author of the Indian epic Rāmāyaṇa.
example_en: Valmiki is the great sage who wrote the Ramayana.

definition: the sickness resulting from eating food contaminated either by bacterial toxins or by certain bacteria, esp. salmonella, often causing vomiting, diarrhoea, and prostration.
example: ಹಳಸಿದ ಆಹಾರ ತಿಂದು ಇಡೀ ಕುಟುಂಬಕ್ಕೆ ಇಕ್ಕುಗುತ್ತ ಬಂದಿತು.
example_en: The whole family suffered from food poisoning after eating spoiled food.

definition: not having offspring.
example_en: That family line remained without offspring.

definition: a man, deity etc. who or a bird which moves in the space.
example_en: Birds move in the sky as creatures of the air.

definition: to become inattentive, careless.
example_en: Becoming careless in his work, he made a mistake.

definition: a man who charges another of wrong doing; charger; an accuser.
example_en: In the court the accuser spoke against the accused.

definition: the bottom surface of the foot; the sole.
example_en: From constant walking, the sole of his foot had become hard.

definition: a low, murmuring sound.
example_en: A low murmuring sound was heard from inside the hut.

definition: a poem or song of lament; an elegy.
example: ಕವಿ ಸ್ನೇಹಿತನ ನಿಧನದ ಬಗ್ಗೆ ವಿಲಾಪಿಕೆ ರಚಿಸಿದನು.
example_en: The poet composed an elegy on the death of his friend.

definition: a saluting by touching one's forehead with the tips of the right hand, standing on ones knees.
example_en: He offered the kneeling salute before the teacher.

definition: a protecting or being protected; protection.
example_en: The government must protect the forests.

definition: the quality or condition of being quite empty; absolute emptiness.
example: ಯುದ್ಧದ ನಂತರ ಆ ಊರಿನಲ್ಲಿ ನಿಶ್ಶೂನ್ಯ ಆವರಿಸಿತ್ತು.
example_en: After the war, absolute emptiness had spread over that town.

definition: following immediately; running behind closely.
example_en: The dog followed close behind its owner.

definition: a rightful claim; a demand for which one is or one thinks he or she is, rightfully eligible.
example_en: She put forward her rightful claim to the ancestral property.

definition: to separate; to divide; to disunite.
example_en: The father divided the property among the children.

definition: a piece or fragment.
example_en: A fragment of glass had fallen on the floor.

definition: a pit or a low, open box-type construction at the altar for the consecrated fire, where offerings are made to a god in a religious sacrifice.
example_en: The priests lit the fire in the sacrificial pit.

definition: the tip of a thorn.
example_en: The tip of the thorn pricked and the finger bled.

definition: a corner, outskirt of a town or village.
example: ಊರಿನ ಗಾವಕೋಸಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಒಂದು ಸಣ್ಣ ಗುಡಿ ಇದೆ.
example_en: There is a small temple in the outskirts of the village.

definition: that what one remembers.
example: ಆ ಹಳೆಯ ಪತ್ರ ಅವಳ ಪಾಲಿಗೆ ಪ್ರೀತಿಯ ನೆನಕೆಯಾಗಿತ್ತು.
example_en: That old letter was a fond remembrance for her.

definition: the cycle of menses in a woman, which normally happens once in every four-weeks.
example_en: The doctor explained to her about the menstrual cycle.

definition: to bite and grind or crush with the teeth; to chew; to masticate.
example_en: The cow was slowly chewing the grass.

definition: the plant Malva verticillata of Malvaceae family.
example_en: People use the leaves of the Malva verticillata plant as greens.

definition: (a nursery term) sleep; sleeping.
example_en: The baby felt sleepy and lay down quietly.

definition: the basic monetary unit of the United Kingdom, equal to 100 (new) pennies (before 1971 it was equal to 20 shillings or 240 pennies); a pound (symbol £).
example: ಆ ಬಟ್ಟೆಯ ಬೆಲೆ ಇಪ್ಪತ್ತು ಪೌಂಡು ಆಗಿತ್ತು.
example_en: The price of that cloth was twenty pounds.

definition: a reproachig in scornful or sarcastic language; taunting; affronting.
example_en: His taunting words hurt everyone.

definition: to strongly crave for.
example: ದೂರದ ಊರಿನ ಸುದ್ದಿ ಕೇಳಿ ಅವನು ಮನೆಗೆ ಹೋಗಲು ಬಾಕುಳಿಗೊಂಡನು.
example_en: Hearing news of his distant village, he strongly craved to go home.

definition: a ray of sunlight.
example_en: The morning ray of sunlight fell into the room.

definition: a barbed spear with a line attached to it, used for spearing whales or other large sea animals; a harpoon.
example_en: The fishermen hunted the big whale with a harpoon.

definition: a hand-fan made of plant leaves.
example_en: In the heat, grandmother fanned herself with a leaf hand-fan.

definition: a clear, deep-red variety of corundum, valued as a precious stone; a ruby.
example_en: A red ruby gleamed in the queen's ring.

definition: the look of sparkling light.
example_en: Her sparkling glance drew everyone's attention.

definition: the quality of being mild, gentle or patient; mildness; gentleness.
example_en: Gentleness was clearly evident in her speech.

definition: the auditorium for general public in a sacrificial ground.
example_en: The common people watched the sacrifice from the public auditorium.

definition: a man who exorts payments from others using force, a coierice method.
example: ಆ ಸುಲಿಹಕಾಱ ಬೀದಿ ವ್ಯಾಪಾರಿಗಳಿಂದ ಹಣ ವಸೂಲಿ ಮಾಡುತ್ತಿದ್ದನು.
example_en: That extortionist used to collect money from street vendors.

definition: name of a famous mythological mountain (believed to be the abode of Brahma.
example_en: Mount Meru is believed to be the abode of Brahma.

definition: a battle or combat.
example: ಆ ಪೋರ್ತ ಇಡೀ ಗ್ರಾಮದ ನೆನಪಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಉಳಿಯಿತು.
example_en: That battle remained in the memory of the whole village.

definition: the foam of the sea.
example: ದಡದ ಬಂಡೆಗಳ ಮೇಲೆ ಕಡಲು ನಾಲಗೆ ಚೆಲ್ಲಿತ್ತು.
example_en: The foam of the sea was scattered over the rocks on the shore.

definition: (dial.) a hard support for writing papers.
example_en: He placed the paper on the writing board to write.

definition: the condition of being tangled, interwoven in a disorderly manner.
example_en: It was hard to undo the tangled state of those threads.

definition: anything on which another leans, rests or depends; a solid support; a prop.
example_en: They grew the creeper by giving it a stick as a prop.

definition: a woman whose husband has died and is not remarried; a widow.
example_en: She became a widow at a young age.

definition: any of various dark-coloured, viscid products with pungent odour obtained from the destructive distillation of certain organic substances, as coal, peat, shale or wood, used for protecting and preserving surfaces; tar.
example_en: They used tar for repairing the road.

definition: an appeal - a) a call upon some authority or person for a decision, opinion, etc.; b) an urgent request for help, sympathy, etc.
example_en: He submitted an appeal to the court.

definition: a mark or scratch made by pressing the nails.
example_en: There was a nail-scratch mark on his hand.

definition: to attack with a military force.
example: ಸೈನ್ಯ ರಾತ್ರಿಯ ಹೊತ್ತು ಕೋಟೆಯ ಮೇಲೆ ಧಾಳಿಯಿಟ್ಟಿತು.
example_en: The army attacked the fort at night with its military force.

definition: sometimes; occasionally; not regularly.
example_en: Sometimes she comes late.

definition: (boredom, aversion; antipathy; repugnance) to be felt intensely.
example_en: When I saw that work, I felt intense repugnance.

definition: an official, usu. periodic, count of population and recording of economic and social status, age, sex, linguistic group, etc.; census.
example: ಸರ್ಕಾರ ಪ್ರತಿ ಹತ್ತು ವರ್ಷಕ್ಕೊಮ್ಮೆ ಜನಗಣತಿ ನಡೆಸುತ್ತದೆ.
example_en: The government conducts a census once every ten years.

definition: a wooden cage.
example_en: He made and kept a wooden cage for the bird.

definition: a sport; a play.
example_en: The children were engrossed in play.

definition: a stabbing weapon consisting of a long shaft and a pointed, metal head; a spear.
example_en: The spear was gleaming in the warrior's hand.

definition: the branch of medicine dealing with the skin and its diseases; dermatology.
example_en: Dermatology includes the treatment of skin diseases.

definition: to fondle; to caress; to pamper.
example_en: The grandmother pampered her grandchild.

definition: to be completed; to be over.
example_en: The work was finally completed.

definition: (pros.) a verse having four lines of twenty six syllables each.
example: ಭುಜಂಗವಿಜೃಂಭಿತ ಛಂದಸ್ಸಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಇಪ್ಪತ್ತಾರು ಅಕ್ಷರಗಳ ನಾಲ್ಕು ಸಾಲುಗಳಿರುತ್ತವೆ.
example_en: The bhujangavijrimbhita metre has four lines of twenty-six syllables each.

definition: the branch of medical science that deals with childhood and the diseases of children; paediatrics.
example_en: That doctor has expertise in paediatrics.

definition: the habit or act of eating greedily too much; gluttony.
example_en: If you give up gluttony, your health will improve.

definition: the act of striking the hands together, as in applauding; clap.
example: ಅವನ ಭಾಷಣದ ನಂತರ ಜನರು ಕೈಪರೆ ಮಾಡಿದರು.
example_en: After his speech, the people clapped.

definition: a variety of screw pine tree.
example_en: There was a screw pine tree beside the garden.

definition: the state or period of deterioration; decadent.
example_en: That institution had reached a state of decline.

definition: the genuine essence of anything.
example: ಆ ಬರಹದಲ್ಲಿ ಗುರುಗಳ ಬೋಧನೆಯ ಅಚ್ಚಕೆಚ್ಚು ಅಡಗಿತ್ತು.
example_en: The genuine essence of the teacher's teaching lay hidden in that writing.

definition: he who is or who keeps himself, away.
example_en: He is one who keeps himself away from everyone.

definition: the expulsion of bad smelling gas, caused by indigestion, through the mouth from the stomach.
example: ಮಸಾಲೆ ಆಹಾರ ತಿಂದ ಮೇಲೆ ಅವನಿಗೆ ಹುಳಿತೇಗು ಬಂದಿತು.
example_en: After eating spicy food, he had a sour burp from indigestion.

definition: one who uses harsh words or speech (as in rebuking, condemning etc.); a denunciator.
example_en: The denunciator harshly condemned everyone in the assembly.

definition: deprivation of consciousness for a brief period; unconsciousness; a fainting; a swoon.
example_en: She fainted due to the intense heat of the sun.

definition: a radio wave reflected from the ionosphere; a sky-wave.
example_en: The radio caught the sky-wave and played the news.

definition: a hump-backed man.
example_en: The hump-backed man was selling vegetables in the market.

definition: a particular design for the border of cloths.
example: ಅವಳ ಸೀರೆಯ ಅಂಚಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಸುಂದರ ನ್ಯಾಮದಡಿ ಇತ್ತು.
example_en: There was a beautiful border design on the edge of her saree.

definition: a Śaiva mendicant.
example: ಆ ಆಂಡಿ ಬೂದಿ ಬಳಿದುಕೊಂಡು ಊರೂರು ಸುತ್ತುತ್ತಿದ್ದ.
example_en: That Śaiva mendicant wandered from village to village smeared with ash.

definition: to burglarise or commit burglary.
example_en: Those thieves committed burglary in the bungalow at night.

definition: grace - a) the unmerited love and favour of god toward mankind; b) divine influence acting in a person to make the person pure, morally strong, etc.
example_en: The devotees prayed for the grace of God.

definition: (a red mark, stain) to stain; to discolour (with such a mark).
example_en: That cloth got stained and discoloured with soot.

definition: the state of having enough or more than enough or a large amount; plentifulness; abundance.
example: ಈ ವರ್ಷ ಮಳೆ ಚೆನ್ನಾಗಿ ಬಂದು ಬಾವಿಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಅಗುಂತಿ ಇದೆ.
example_en: This year the rain was good, so there is abundance in the wells.

definition: the act, process or fact of moving by trotting.
example_en: The ground shook from the horse's trotting.

example_en: The doctor prescribed a medicine that prevents kidney stones.

definition: a work, job, undertaking that is or is to be done by underaker alone.
example_en: I alone must finish this task.

definition: the first place; the foremost rank.
example_en: He secured the first place in the competition.

definition: not having teeth; toothless.
example_en: It is difficult for the toothless old man to eat.

definition: the quality or fact of being low in price or cost; cheapness; inexpensiveness.
example: ಅಂಗಡಿಯವನು ಬಟ್ಟೆಯ ಸವೀಕ ತೋರಿಸಿ ಗ್ರಾಹಕರನ್ನು ಕರೆದನು.
example_en: The shopkeeper showed off the cheapness of the cloth and called the customers.

definition: an answer or response, in speech or writing; a reply.
example: ಒಂದು ವಾರದ ನಂತರ ಅವನಿಗೆ ಮಱುವಾತು ಬಂದಿತು.
example_en: After a week, a reply came to him.

definition: (vīr.) a man who is a servant of a multitude of devotees.
example: ಅವನು ಭಕ್ತರ ಸಮೂಹಕ್ಕೆ ಸೇವಕನಾದ ಬಳಗದೊತ್ತು ಆಗಿದ್ದಾನೆ.
example_en: He is a servant of a multitude of devotees.

definition: to rob or despoil (a person or place) by force; to plunder; to rob.
example_en: The bandits plundered the village.

definition: to be or become separated from.
example_en: Those two creepers became separated.

definition: resounding or reechoing; resonant.
example_en: His voice sounded resonant inside the cave.

definition: protected, guarded well.
example: ಆ ಮಗು ಪೋಷಕರಿಂದ ಪರಿರಕ್ಷಿತ ಆಗಿ ಬೆಳೆಯಿತು.
example_en: That child grew up well protected by its parents.

definition: the act of stitching, sewing.
example_en: This stitching is very strong.

definition: to cause to become erect, stiff and rigid.
example: ಗಾಳಿ ಬೀಸಿ ಬಿದ್ದ ಮರವನ್ನು ಮಿಳಿರ್ಚಲು ಯಾರಿಂದಲೂ ಆಗಲಿಲ್ಲ.
example_en: No one could make the tree that had fallen in the wind stand stiff and erect again.

definition: a man who is afraid of; a terrorised man.
example: ಯುದ್ಧದ ನಂತರ ಆ ತಲ್ಲಣಿಗ ಮನೆಗೆ ಹೋಗಲು ಹೆದರುತ್ತಿದ್ದನು.
example_en: After the war, that terrified man was afraid to go home.

definition: a person who tends to pick up the left over grains on the agricultural field; a person who lives on such collection; a gleaner.
example: ಬಡ ಆಯ್ಕುಳಿ ಹೊಲದಲ್ಲಿ ಬಿದ್ದ ಕಾಳುಗಳನ್ನು ಆಯ್ದನು.
example_en: The poor gleaner collected the fallen grains in the field.

definition: the plant Momordica balsamina of Cucurbitaceae family.
example_en: The fruit of the balsam apple vine is used as medicine.

definition: name of a country, currently known as Orissa (or Oḍissa), in eastern India.
example_en: The temples of the Vaddi (Odisha) region are famous.

definition: money paid to an employee for work done, on an hourly, daily or piecework basis; wages.
example_en: The contractor paid the wages to the laborers.

definition: the plant Baliospermum montanum (= Croton polyandrus) of Euphorbiaceae family.
example_en: A Baliospermum montanum plant has grown at the edge of the forest.

definition: a variety of great millet (sorghum) plant.
example_en: This variety of sorghum is grown in dry regions.

definition: Indra, the king of gods.
example_en: The gods praised Indra, the king of gods.

definition: greatness of the mind; large-heartedness; reputation based on character, etc.
example_en: The teacher's large-heartedness was a model for the students.

definition: a restive horse.
example_en: Even when the reins were pulled, the restive horse did not stop.

definition: two times.
example_en: He had gone to the temple twice.

definition: a lean, lanky man.
example_en: That lean lanky man looked emaciated.

definition: an afflicted condition; pain; suffering; affliction.
example_en: He was suffering affliction from worry over the debt.

definition: having wicked, evil thoughts.
example_en: Harm comes to society from evil-minded people.

definition: totalling twenty-four.
example_en: There are twenty-four houses in that village.

definition: a piece of wood used as fuel.
example_en: She split the piece of firewood and put it into the stove.

definition: a virus disease attacking the upper respiratory tract; influenza.
example_en: In winter, influenza afflicts many people.

definition: lack of strength; weakness; feeblenes.
example_en: Weakness appeared in his body due to illness.

definition: (erot.) an instance of having sexual intercourse with two women at a time.
example: ಆ ಕಥೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಸ್ತ್ರೀಯುಗಳ ಪ್ರಸ್ತಾಪ ಬಹಿರಂಗವಾಗಿ ಬಂದಿದೆ.
example_en: In that story, a mention of intercourse with two women is made openly.

definition: the second marriage of a woman (following the death of her earlier husband); a widow marriage.
example_en: The social reformers encouraged widow remarriage.

definition: a man who owns or operates a shop or a small store; a shop-keeper.
example: ಈ ವಾಟಿಕಾರ ಪ್ರತಿದಿನ ಬೆಳಿಗ್ಗೆ ಅಂಗಡಿ ತೆರೆಯುತ್ತಾನೆ.
example_en: This shop-keeper opens his shop every morning.

definition: to be extremely modest.
example_en: The new daughter-in-law was extremely modest before her mother-in-law.
